# Ashirwad Plastics

> Manufacturer of precision primary packaging and drug delivery systems for pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and cosmetic industries, headquartered in Solan, Himachal Pradesh, India.

Ashirwad Plastics designs and manufactures cleanroom-grade plastic packaging solutions including ophthalmic delivery systems, nasal sprays, tablet containers, protein jars, flip-off seals, oral droppers, measuring caps, and personal care closures.

## Products

- [Ophthalmic Delivery Systems](https://www.ashirwadplastics.com/products/ophthalmic): Sterile eye dropper bottles, nozzles, and tamper-evident closures.
- [Nasal Delivery Systems](https://www.ashirwadplastics.com/products/nasal): Precision nasal spray pumps, bottles, and actuators.
- [Tablet Containers & Closures](https://www.ashirwadplastics.com/products/tablet): HDPE tablet bottles with child-resistant and desiccant closures.
- [Protein Jars](https://www.ashirwadplastics.com/products/protein-jars): Wide-mouth nutraceutical and sports nutrition jars.
- [Flip-Off Seals](https://www.ashirwadplastics.com/products/flip-off): Aluminum-plastic flip-off vial seals for injectables.
- [Oral Droppers & Measuring Caps](https://www.ashirwadplastics.com/products/measuring): Graduated dosing cups, pipettes, and oral liquid droppers.
- [Personal Care Bottles & Closures](https://www.ashirwadplastics.com/products/personal-care): Cosmetic bottles, dispensing pumps, and sprayers.
- [Caps & Closures](https://www.ashirwadplastics.com/products/caps-closures): Tamper-evident, CRC, and specialty plastic closures.

## Market Sectors

- [Pharmaceutical](https://www.ashirwadplastics.com/market/pharma): Primary packaging and drug delivery systems for pharma.
- [Nutraceutical](https://www.ashirwadplastics.com/market/nutraceutical): Packaging solutions for supplements and nutrition.
- [Cosmetic](https://www.ashirwadplastics.com/market/cosmetic): Packaging for personal care and beauty formulations.
